Green means “On time” - within a minute and a half of the schedule, either way
Blue means “Running late” - a minute and a half or more behind schedule
Red means “Running early” - more than a minute and a half ahead of schedule, so it may leave before you get there
Gray means “Scheduled arrival” - We don’t know where the bus is now, but the schedule says there is an upcoming arrival
Gray with strikethrough means the trip has been canceled - this bus is NOT coming
